Product descriptions

Ahh Moments Cherry Berry Shot Sleepy is a 1:1 THC:CBN indica tincture crafted to help you unwind and drift into restful slumber. This 20mg shot delivers a balanced blend of THC and CBN in a delicious cherry berry flavor profile that makes bedtime something to look forward to. The indica classification promotes deep relaxation and sleepy effects, ideal for those seeking relief from restlessness or simply wanting to enhance their nighttime routine. Each shot is perfectly portioned for convenient, fast-acting delivery, allowing you to find your sweet spot without the guesswork. The tart-sweet cherry and berry notes create a pleasant tasting experience that masks any herbal undertones. Whether you're dealing with occasional sleeplessness or just want to elevate your evening wind-down ritual, this tincture offers a discreet, easy-to-use solution that fits seamlessly into your lifestyle. Simply take your shot and let the calming effects wash over you as you drift into peaceful, restorative rest.
